counting_policy.duplicate_weight: Occurrence count is the number of matching rows in the supplied combined playlist. It is a preference signal requested by the user, not a listening playcount or proof of the number of distinct years.
counting_policy.grouping: Casefold-exact song title plus full displayed artist-credit string. No fuzzy matching, punctuation normalization, credit reordering or cross-version merging. Live, acoustic, remix and differently credited versions remain separate whenever their displayed titles or credits differ.
counting_policy.position_meaning: rank in tracks means the original row position in the combined playlist, not an overall listening rank.
counting_policy.sorting: Descending occurrence count; earliest playlist position is only a deterministic tie-breaker. Equal counts carry equal repeat weight.
counting_policy.exclusions: Any row crediting Dance Gavin Dance or Dwellings remains in the complete raw occurrence list and is omitted from the eligible preference ranking.
counting_policy.identity_limits: Only positions 1–100 have Spotify URIs checked against public embed data. No URI is invented or copied to other positions. Grouping by displayed title and credits does not prove that all grouped rows share one Spotify recording URI.
counting_policy.artist_counts: Artist tables group the complete displayed artist-credit string, without splitting collaborations into individual artists. They count playlist occurrences, not plays.
